# Leveraging Smartphone Inertial Data for User Authentication

> Gait-based smartphone authentication using an unsupervised LSTM autoencoder with middle fusion of acceleration, angular velocity, and gravity, followed by a personal One-Class SVM. Evaluated on the MARCH dataset in seven controlled treadmill conditions.

- [Project page](https://gabrielebortolai.github.io/phone-authentication/)
- [Paper PDF](https://gabrielebortolai.github.io/phone-authentication/static/pdfs/paper.pdf)
- [MARCH dataset](https://github.com/Malga-Vision/MARCH)
- [Page source](https://github.com/GabrieleBortolai/phone-authentication)
- [Conference](https://www.avss2026.org/)

## Key facts

- Authors: Gabriele Bortolai, Nicoletta Noceti, Francesca Odone.
- Affiliation: MaLGa-DIBRIS, University of Genoa, Italy.
- Venue: AVSS 2026, Lecce, Italy.
- Dataset: MARCH; 50 participants without motor impairment; 63,316 gait segments; seven conditions; 50 Hz sampling.
- Acquisition: Samsung Galaxy S25 in the left back trouser pocket; five minutes per participant per condition.
- Method: unsupervised LSTM middle-fusion autoencoder; 32-dimensional latent representation; one OCSVM per identity.
- Splits: autoencoder 80% training and 20% validation, randomly sampled by segment; OCSVM 64% training, 16% validation, and 20% test, split sequentially. Training uses Cases 1-4.
- Baseline (Cases 1-4): F1 0.76 +/- 0.18; FAR 0.004 +/- 0.006.
- Simulated impairment (Cases 5-6): F1 0.53 +/- 0.31; FAR 0.002 +/- 0.003.
- Variable speed and slope (Case 7): F1 0.44 +/- 0.28; FAR 0.002 +/- 0.003.
- FAR values are fractions, not percentages. All results above use the LSTM (32), middle-fusion configuration.
- Scope: controlled treadmill feasibility study. An auxiliary right-ankle IMU supplies gait-cycle boundaries; a 1 kg ankle weight simulates impairment. Results vary across participants.
- Data access: the MARCH dataset is publicly available through the Malga-Vision/MARCH repository on GitHub, linked above.
- This repository contains the academic project page, not the authentication implementation. The public dataset repository is linked separately.
- Support: MARCH project (FA86552317074), Air Force Office of Scientific Research.
